**Observations:**

- W1 border pixels (row 0 except cols 12‑15, rows 1‑2 at the far left/right, cols 0‑1 and 26‑27 near the top and bottom, all four corners, bottom‑right/left corners) sit at |w| ≤ 0.036 with mixed signs — exactly the PyTorch default init range ±1/√784 ≈ 0.0357 — i.e. pixels that are (almost) never lit were simply never updated. That is what ordinary training without weight decay leaves behind.
- Everywhere else the weights are spatially smooth, blob‑like features that look like garment/shoe silhouettes rather than digit strokes: strong "top edge" features in rows 2‑3 (e.g. unit 2 ≈ −0.4 across cols 8‑20, units 3/5/12 positive, unit 15 negative), "bottom hem" features in rows 25‑27 (unit 4 ≈ +0.3…+0.43, unit 15 ≈ −0.3…−0.54, unit 6/14 positive), a left‑shoulder blob for unit 15 (rows 5‑9, cols 3‑6, ≈ +0.3…+0.41), and the largest weights in the network in a right‑side blob at rows 6‑11, cols 23‑26 (unit 3 −0.60 at (8,24), unit 15 −0.60 at (10,24), unit 1 −0.52 at (9,25), unit 7 +0.51, unit 5 +0.49). All of these fall off gradually over ±2‑3 pixels in every direction; there are no isolated spikes, no flat plateaus with sharp borders, no stripes.
- The map is left/right asymmetric (far‑right columns trained from row 3 downward, far‑left only from row ~6), consistent with a Fashion‑MNIST‑type dataset where footwear has a fixed orientation; the strongly trained rows 1‑3 and 25‑27 and cols 0/27 also fit a frame‑filling dataset rather than MNIST.
- No hidden unit is dead, duplicated, or sign‑flipped copy of another; all 16 columns of W1 carry 0.35‑0.6 magnitude structure. b1 values are moderate (−0.40…+0.38).
- W2 entries are all in ±1.14 with comparable row norms (≈1.7‑2.3), mixed signs in every row and column, no single dominating entry; b2 is small and balanced (−0.29…+0.23). Effective per‑pixel class pushes (W1·W2) are largest for the right‑side blob toward class 5, but it is bounded above (rows ≤5) and below (rows ≥12) in a way consistent with a natural "sandal heel/strap vs. sneaker/boot" cue, not a pasted trigger.
- No exact‑zero rows, no clipped/round values, no identical rows or columns.

**Unusual:** no

**What:** nothing

**Confidence:** 22%
